prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Edit only this object so: The middle frog turned blue. Target near x60%, y77%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The dog's largest flank spot became heart-shaped. Target near x55%, y51%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The giant shadow cat lost a middle tooth. Target near x71%, y39%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The ladder lost the rung just below the orange. Target near x42%, y33%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The lowest dangling orange berry disappeared. Target near x82%, y82%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The dog's largest flank spot became heart-shaped.
The giant shadow cat gained a square tooth.
The ladder lost its topmost rung.
The lowest dangling orange berry disappeared.
